stem: Select TWO actions that support this requirement: Designing a security strategy for multiple AWS accounts (for example, AWS Control Tower, service control policies [SCPs])

choices.text: Validate with official documentation before applying
Store AWS access keys in the workbook git repo
Skip teardown if the instance is stopped
Use root credentials for every lab step
Design against the stated requirement and document tradeoffs

rationale: A and B are sound exam/lab practice. C/D/E violate credential, teardown, or root-user rules.
